title: effective_contact comment claims NULLIF(corrected) convention the new SQL does not use
evidence:
+/// Effective contact = corrected value when present (non-empty), else the
+/// immutable snapshot (AD-7). A corrected '' is treated as absent (falls back
+/// to the snapshot), matching the SQL `NULLIF(corrected,'')` convention.
...
+       COALESCE(rc.corrected_email, rc.contact_email, '') AS effective_email,
+       COALESCE(rc.corrected_phone, rc.contact_phone, '') AS effective_phone
...
+       COALESCE(rc.corrected_email, rc.contact_email) = NULLIF($3, '')
+    OR COALESCE(rc.corrected_phone, rc.contact_phone) = NULLIF($4, '')
detail: Comment asserts SQL uses NULLIF(corrected,''); both new SQL files use plain COALESCE on corrected_*. The NULLIF is on the param, not corrected. If corrected can be '', trigger (reads SQL-COALESCE'd effective via from_effective) and form_handler (Gleam effective_contact) disagree on effective contact.
recommended_fix: Wrap corrected in NULLIF inside both COALESCEs: COALESCE(NULLIF(rc.corrected_email,''), rc.contact_email, '') — matches the documented intent and the Gleam effective_contact helper.

title: sprint-status last_updated regressed while rc3-7 status advanced
detail: rc3-7 advanced backlog to review in this same edit, yet last_updated moved 08-12 to 08-11. A status advance is itself an update; the timestamp regressing is contradictory.
recommended_fix: Set last_updated to the actual edit date (>= 2026-08-12), not 2026-08-11.
